programs.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
programs.desc: Air ambulances bring the emergency room to critically ill or injured people across the country, including a man in cardiac arrest and a woman who's been trampled by a foal.

programs.title: Wonders of the World I Can't See
programs.desc: Chris McCausland and Liza Tarbuck go to Canada to experience Niagara Falls. Chris is especially excited to visit a wonder that actually makes a noise.

programs.title: Extraordinary Escapes with Sandi Toksvig
programs.desc: In the Midlands, Sandi takes Rosie Jones to a unique eco-lodge complete with a disco bathroom, a rebooted 70s beach house and a charming historical hideaway.

programs.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programs.desc: Gordon visits Flamangos in rural New Jersey, where mother and daughter Adele and Cheryl are stuck in their tropical ways. But their restaurant is far from paradise.

programs.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programs.desc: In Blackburn, Carla and Marcus serve up a risky soufflé, competitive cooks Michael and Joanna strive for perfection, and Trudy and Anselm take a laid-back approach.

programs.title: Sarah Beeny's New Country Lives
programs.desc: James and Jodie find out more about how to make their 17th-century farmhouse watertight, while Emma and James plan to take two alpacas paddling at the beach.
